diagnosis: First invoice after a mid-cycle upgrade; the difference is the proration credit and charge lines.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. The first invoice after an upgrade is prorated: you see a credit for the unused days on the previous plan followed by a charge for the new plan, so the total differs from the list price for that one invoice only. Subsequent invoices match the plan price. See "Understanding mid-cycle proration on plan upgrades" (kb-0001) for the full details.
